name: tasks
description: Evaluation items with answer keys, built from the verified text by rule: complete the second line, name the chapter, verify a quote (exact or a real attested variant), and fill a masked word. Altered items whose reading is carried only under CC-BY-SA are left out.

fields.name: prompt_ta
fields.description: The prompt, in Tamil text taken from the dataset.

fields.name: choices
fields.description: Choices for multiple-choice items; null otherwise.

fields.name: note
fields.description: For an altered verify_quote item: which attested reading it is.

fields.name: canary
fields.description: The dataset's canary string, the same on every row (BIG-bench practice): if a model can complete it, this file was in its training data. Keep it when you copy the tasks.
